instrument: Palm Beach County pause on new large data center applications (Sept 24, 2026)
summary: Commission voted 6-0 to pause new applications for large data centers for up to one year while writing rules on noise, water, electricity and proximity to homes; a smaller approved project (Project Tango) remains approved.
notes: Commissioners denied Project Tango 5-1 (without prejudice); a previously approved Central Park Commerce Center (202 acres) allows 206,000 sq ft of data center space with no conditions of approval (WPTV).
